notes.title: Launcher Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40031675/f06d1cfc13a2d876e4d43e1f9953c0c78669239a.png

Welcome to the new update! 
We have added a special FoxSox Games Launcher to our games. 
The launcher automatically starts only when you begin the game and closes immediately after the game starts. Its main purpose is to inform you about the latest updates in our game offerings. This is an optional feature, so you can choose to skip it and go directly to the game by selecting the appropriate option when launching the game.

Additionally, we've implemented a few minor improvements that enhance performance and fix some minor bugs in the game.

notes.title: Update 1.6
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40031675/10daeb20493e8712b26a6518d0df13c64dcb060a.jpg

First update in 2022.

- The game starts from now on in a window with a native resolution of 960x540 px (the resolution can be freely adjusted by editing the window or run in fullscreen)
- Fixed problem with steering on map 4 with "King Olvelius" skin
- Control with gamepad temporarily removed because it was causing problems with the framerate.
- Fixed some minor bugs.

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.notes:
New big changes to The Last Order: Dungeons!

First, I decided to change the price of the game ~ -67%.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40031675/52c65602f1bda19fcfd9b850f3ab50333592c3ce.png

Second, a few months after the premiere, I can see that the game is still too difficult for many players. Therefore, from now on, the duration of the campaign will depend on the selected difficulty level.

Easy - 20 seconds per segment (a total of 100 seconds per level)
Normal - 40 seconds per segment (a total of 200 seconds per level)
Hard - 60 seconds per segment (total 300 seconds per level)

Due to these changes, the freeplay mode will be available again after completing the campaign and not as it is now from the very beginning of the game.

Third, some minor bugs were fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.4 - Game balance.
notes.notes:
Another update that helps balance the game. From now on, freeplay mode is available from the very beginning of the game, which will help you level up your characters faster, making it easier for you to progress through the campaign levels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40031675/c32e5d0a067828ff194f3a6881dd2e6497c1d2c7.jpg

Additionally, new sound effects have been added for the loss of life and some minor bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.3 - Quick Game
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40031675/3eb4ed667bc2771a3c213743f21b52697a588cf2.jpg

A new update adding a new mode, Quick Game is now available to everyone on Steam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40031675/3ecad7df765e0e5026e9540329a158d871f8abbf.png 

The new mode can be played at any time, at any level of your gaming experience. At the beginning you can choose which character you want to play and the difficulty level. In this new mode you can break your own records on a new map, specially prepared for this mode!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40031675/276959d6ed07618dabb8d473676e00d05d26fad9.png

notes.title: Update 1.2.1 - Change the difficulty level.
notes.notes:
Another update to help you adapt the game to your skills.
From now on, the game starts on the lowest difficulty level. Three modes are available:
Easy - You start the game with three lives.
Medium - You start the game with two lives.
Hard - You start the game with one life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40031675/503a923e972ae02d91f7a1f6ea2a5d6eec91dc68.png

You can change the difficulty level in the settings. More lives you can still be unlocked at a higher level of your heroes. (maximum three lives)

notes.title: Update 1.2 - Training Mode
notes.notes:
Update 1.2

After the premiere, I noticed how difficult is my game. So I decided to prepare a special training mode that will help you learn mechanics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40031675/4e8416e029198a69957ec19bdf12e340754122c3.png

In the new mode, you can choose the character you want to play and adjust the difficulty level to our own requirements.
You can choose the character level, the number of lives and the strength of enemies, all on a specially prepared map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40031675/8cf807658d014c5f7e5f216cd936f9b0dd870302.png
